verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Copilot chat is restricted to specific IDEs (VS Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio) rather than exposed via a general API, and probes for an OpenAPI/swagger spec all returned 404, indicating no documented API surface mirroring UI capabilities. While a CLI exists, there is no evidence that all UI functionality (chat, agent mode, code review, MCP management) is programmatically accessible via an API.
